question: On the exact one frozen candidate, which equally supported registered producer-consumer packages show held-out causal complementarity, target-aspect separation, mechanism witnesses and acceptable duration/reliability?
method: One non-adaptive mechanism-blocked causal panel. Every tested package receives the same 128 policy identities, research seeds, target/control aspects and complete none/A/B/AB design. No package is extended from observed promise.

entryGate.freeze: The execution manifest must bind this protocol, runner, probe, zero-row audit, ledger identity and every numeric ceiling before the first causal-panel observation.

candidate.selectionAuthority: Exactly one candidate was frozen by protocol a27eaf916c61bef5d227c6224cf3b94042094269eaeb08a46c7100278bd84d2d and independently confirmed by protocol d8496263dbaab0534cf44702e9ea1078c952b87c145b5c04b3492085d6f15be0.

evidence.use: Immutable admission and independent reproduction evidence only; do not reconstruct or rerun the exhausted research path.

immutableAdmittedAshHandSizePackage.exactCandidateIdentity: The candidate and live catalogues have byte-identical canonical Preparation and Phantom Blades definitions. This protocol verifies that identity before execution and deliberately does not rerun the admitted hand-size research.

admissionSet.successSet: Both Dusk packages and at least one equally evaluated supplemental Ash package must clear. Together with immutable independently reproduced hand-size-payoff, this establishes at least two packages per aspect while preserving every additional clear Ash package.

producerPresence.intervention: Replace the fixed producer slot with the registered producer when present, otherwise the registered neutral filler.

consumerPresence.intervention: Replace the fixed consumer slot with the registered consumer when present, otherwise the registered neutral filler.

aspect.intervention: Run the identical deck, policy and seed once in the package's target aspect and once in the other aspect.

package.blocking: Package is a mechanism block, not a pooled numeric factor. No cross-package main effect is estimated.

designMatrix.deckIdentity: Every arm has exactly ten cards. Non-intervened slots, enemy, unlocks, aspect, policy and research seed are identical within a causal block.
designMatrix.aliasStructure: There are no physical aliases between packages because their decks and response metrics differ. Within a package, the same none/A/B/AB cells support both conditional and interaction estimands; they are simulated once.

cohort.commonRandomNumbers: For a given index/seed, every package receives both aspects and all four arms. No package, aspect or arm receives extra identities or a different first look.
cohort.independence: Root 547 and seeds 346000-346127 are disjoint from the root-540/541 exact-content local evidence, root-545 first look and root-546 whole-run held-out confirmation.

estimands.conditionalProducerEffect: Within each package and aspect, consumer-card response AB minus B. This isolates the registered producer's contribution when the consumer is available.
estimands.producerConsumerInteraction: Within each package and aspect, consumer-card response AB minus A minus B plus none. This is the preregistered complementarity interaction; its sign is normalised by cardMetricDirection.
estimands.targetMinusControlInteraction: For each policy/seed, target-aspect producer-consumer interaction minus the matched other-aspect interaction.
estimands.mechanismWitness: A target-aspect AB row has positive interaction and the registered producer application plus consumer use is visible in card-level event metrics.
estimands.duration: For target-aspect blocks where all arms win, AB turns minus the minimum turns among none, A and B. No missing block may support admission.

estimator.unit: The frozen policy-index/research-seed identity is the paired causal unit.
estimator.standardisation: Conditional and interaction contrasts are divided by the population standard deviation of all four target-aspect arm responses for that package. A zero contrast on zero scale maps to zero; a non-zero constant contrast maps to signed infinity.
estimator.bootstrap: Exactly 5000 deterministic paired bootstrap resamples with a fresh random.Random(421) stream per estimand.
estimator.multiplicity: No package, metric, contrast, threshold, cohort or bootstrap seed may be added or changed after the first observation.

gates.conditionalEffect: The lower 95% bound of the standardised target-aspect AB-minus-B effect is at least 0.25.
gates.interaction: The lower 95% bound of the standardised target-aspect AB-A-B+none interaction is at least 0.25.
gates.aspectSeparation: The lower 95% bound of the raw target-minus-control interaction is greater than zero.
gates.reliability: All 1,024 rows per package are stall/error-free and AB adds no fault relative to its matched other arms.
gates.duration: There are no missing target blocks and the upper 95% bound of AB-minus-best-single duration is at most 0.25 turns.
gates.admission: Both required Dusk packages and at least one supplemental Ash package pass every package gate. Every additional clear Ash package is retained; an unclear or failed surplus Ash package cannot substitute for a required Dusk package.

decisionRules.success: Both required Dusk packages and at least one supplemental Ash package clear every registered gate. Admit the exact complementarity set and continue to deterministic detector construction without changing the candidate.
decisionRules.futility: A required Dusk package decisively fails, or fewer than one supplemental Ash package can still clear because their registered upper bounds, witness/fault/duration outcomes decisively fail. Reject the candidate, close the scalar family and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The success set is not met, but at least one still-required package has no decisive failure; or execution reaches an immutable-input, incomplete-rectangle, cache, engine, harness, row-cap or wall-cap fault. Record inconclusive at the cap and do not rerun or extend this protocol.
decisionRules.successAuthority: The exact candidate has the package-level complementarity set needed for detector construction. This does not admit the detector, authorise product promotion or authorise acceptance/reserve seeds.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: The scalar candidate and family are closed. Continue structurally inside issue #421; do not select another observed scalar cell.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Stop this protocol at decision boundary 3. Do not add rows, alter the package set or rerun.

deterministicOwnership: post_v38_exact_complementarity.py alone constructs all four equal package rectangles, invokes the bound simulator/cache, fits every registered estimand, applies gates and selects the decision boundary with zero model-context tokens.

methodBoundary.adaptiveTuning: Alternative scalar cells, package-specific extensions, promising-package support and V39-style tuning are forbidden.
